tagline: Build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary revenue driver for Meta, reflecting the performance of Facebook and Instagram advertising platforms amid increasing competition and evolving regulatory landscape

kpis.name: Advertising Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from advertisements on Facebook, Instagram, and other services within the Family of Apps
kpis.description: Advertising revenue represents nearly all of Meta's revenue, primarily driven by Facebook and Instagram
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by a 12% increase in ad impressions and a 9% rise in average price per ad

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated revenue from Meta, including Family of Apps (primarily advertising) and Reality Labs (VR/AR hardware)
kpis.description: Total revenue consolidates the Family of Apps and Reality Labs segments
kpis.signal: Robust total revenue growth driven by strong advertising performance in the Family of Apps

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Meta's gross margin calculated by subtracting direct costs from total revenue
kpis.description: Gross margin remains high due to the scalable nature of digital platforms
kpis.signal: High and stable gross margin reflecting the highly profitable business model of the advertising platform

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated operating margin including Reality Labs losses and Family of Apps profitability
kpis.description: Operating margin reflects the balance between Family of Apps profitability and significant investments in AI and Reality Labs
kpis.signal: Slight operating margin compression despite revenue growth, due to rising infrastructure and personnel costs

kpis.name: R&D Expenses (Reality Labs)
kpis.explanation: Total costs from the Reality Labs segment, including R&D, marketing, and infrastructure for VR/AR technologies
kpis.description: Reality Labs generates significant losses but represents a strategic bet on the next generation of platforms
kpis.signal: Sustained investments in the metaverse and immersive technologies despite ongoing operating losses

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital investments including data centers, server equipment, and lease payments to support AI infrastructure
kpis.description: Capex includes finance lease payments and reflects intensified investment in AI infrastructure
kpis.signal: Massive investments in infrastructure to support AI models, content recommendations, and platform growth

kpis.name: DAP
kpis.description: DAP (Bn $). Metric tracked annually by company analysts, historical values over the last 8 years.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of $366.02 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Family Daily Active People (DAP)
kpis.explanation: Average number of unique users logging in daily to at least one product in the Family of Apps as of December 2025
kpis.description: Aggregate engagement metric measuring the daily reach of Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger platforms
kpis.signal: Sustained growth in daily active audience despite competition in younger demographics

kpis.name: Ad Impressions Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth rate of the total number of advertising impressions delivered across the Family of Apps
kpis.description: Impressions growth is driven by increased time spent on platforms and adoption of new video formats
kpis.signal: Increased impression volume reflecting higher engagement and Reels expansion

kpis.name: Average Price per Ad
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year change in the average price advertisers pay per advertising impression
kpis.description: Rising price per ad reflects improved effectiveness of AI-powered advertising tools
kpis.signal: Improved ad pricing due to AI-driven enhancements in targeting and measurement, despite regulatory constraints

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Loss or reduction of advertiser spending
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned early and repeated multiple times, emphasizing that nearly all revenue comes from advertising. The strength of language ('seriously harm our business') and context (lack of long-term advertiser commitments) indicate high severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Complex and evolving privacy and data regulations
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed with a long list of specific regulations (GDPR, DMA, DSA, etc.) and potential impacts on data transfers and operations. The strength of language ('complex and evolving', 'materially and adversely affected') and mention of litigation and investigations confirm its severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Erosion of user base and engagement
risks.score_rationale: This risk is framed as essential to success ('critical to our success') and detailed with numerous potential factors (competition, product changes, user perception). The strength of language ('significantly harmed', 'material and adverse impact') and competitive context (TikTok) justify high severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data breach risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly identified in the 'Data, Security, Platform Integrity, and Intellectual Property' section. The potential impact of 'security breaches' and 'cyber incidents' is emphasized, justifying significant severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Failure of new products or changes to existing products
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in 'Risks Related to Our Product Offerings' and highlights the importance of innovation. Failure to attract or retain users with new products or changes could affect revenue. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Litigation and government actions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned multiple times, particularly in 'Business Operations' and 'Government Regulation' sections. The strength of language ('litigation, including class action lawsuits', 'government investigations, enforcement actions, and settlements') indicates a major concern. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on mobile operating systems
risks.score_rationale: This risk is listed in 'Risks Related to Our Product Offerings' and concerns reliance on key partners such as Apple and Google. Changes in these relationships or operating systems could affect distribution and user experience. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Meta is advancing AI through its Scale AI initiative and investing in data centers to support its AI research and development activities. The company is also continuing to invest in AI-related companies such as Jio Platforms Limited.
